## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] User-facing text is in `apps/web/messages/*.json`, in every locale
- [ ] New API errors have a code in `packages/shared` and a message in every locale
- [ ] Schema changes are one small migration with only agreed models
